title: Image Understanding — crop to PTC JSON

diagrams.title: Worker pipeline
diagrams.blurb: Only the order/options crop goes to Image Understanding. Docling stays local on the full page. Merge both arms into ptc.json.

diagrams.title: Image Understanding call
diagrams.blurb: Encode the crop as a data URL, send it with the Product Type Contract prompt, then parse the model’s JSON (strip accidental fences first).
diagrams.source:

detail = high"] CALL["chat.sample()
or responses.create"] STRIP["Strip markdown fences"] PARSE["json.loads"] OUT["Contract fragment"] FILE --> SIZE SIZE -->|yes| B64 SIZE -->|no| FAIL["Raise ValueError"] B64 --> MSG --> CALL --> STRIP --> PARSE --> OUT

diagrams.title: Two equivalent clients
diagrams.blurb: Same key, same model, same prompt. xAI SDK or the OpenAI-compatible client against api.x.ai. Billing is API tokens — not SuperGrok quota.

diagrams.title: Quick check
diagrams.blurb: A real order-box crop plus the API key should return model.verbatim and options. If the SDK field name differs, print the response once and map it.

diagrams.title: JSON contract fragment
diagrams.blurb: Return only valid JSON. Read option letters from their positions. Do not invent order. Unclear relationships stay null with lower confidence.
diagrams.source:
---
config:
  theme: base
  themeVariables:
    darkMode: true
    background: transparent
    primaryColor: "#1c1e21"
    primaryTextColor: "#ecece6"
    primaryBorderColor: "#4d5358"
    lineColor: "#9aa3a8"
    secondaryColor: "#24272b"
    tertiaryColor: "#151719"
    fontFamily: "IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif"
    fontSize: "14px"
    clusterBkg: "#141618"
    clusterBorder: "#3a3f44"
    titleColor: "#ecece6"
    edgeLabelBackground: "#151719"
    nodeTextColor: "#ecece6"
---
flowchart TB
  ROOT["root"]
  MODEL["model"]
  CONF["confidence : number"]
  NOTES["notes : string[]"]
  VERB["verbatim : string"]
  SERIES["series : string | null"]
  OPTS["options[]"]
  CODE["code : string"]
  ROLE["role : string | null"]
  MEAN["meaning : string | null"]

  ROOT --> MODEL
  ROOT --> CONF
  ROOT --> NOTES
  MODEL --> VERB
  MODEL --> SERIES
  MODEL --> OPTS
  OPTS --> CODE
  OPTS --> ROLE
  OPTS --> MEAN
